name: Net Stalker ~Kyouhaku kara Ryoujoku e~
source:
Main character attends a computer class at school and discovers nasty and humiliation pictures of his classmates. Once the secret is known, his curiosity turns into intimidation and then to insult. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学校的计算机课上发现同班同学不雅且受辱的照片。秘密一旦知晓，他的好奇心便转为恐吓，继而变成凌辱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
